hypothesis: The closed libnc CPU kernels partition independent output coordinates at T4 without changing within-coordinate reduction order, preserving Compact5 archive bytes while materially reducing batch-1 runtime.
kill_condition: Retire unchanged on any archive byte difference, roundtrip or determinism failure, package above 249000 bytes, memory failure, or elapsed reduction below 25 percent.
promotion_condition: On exact 10K, require archive SHA identity with Compact5 batch-1, exact roundtrip, deterministic re-encode, decimal-memory compliance, and at least 25 percent lower elapsed time before any mature gate.
retired_neighborhoods: parallel reduction without exact archive identity
title: Four-thread row-parallel Compact5 NNCP
